program.section_heading: Associate in Science in VOCATIONAL NURSING with emphasis on employment preparation
outcomes: Uses effective communication skills in the nursing role, in therapeutic relationships with clients and families, and in collaboration with the healthcare team. (ILOs: Communication)
Display competency in documentation of patient care issue. (ILOs: Communication)
Assesses basic physical, emotional, spiritual and socio-cultural needs of a client. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Formulate interventions based on assessments and provide safe competent nursing care using accepted standards of practice. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Evaluate care to determine priorities, goals, effectiveness of care, and the need for appropriate referrals. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Adhere to the nursing code of ethics. (ILOs: Ethics)
Practice within the scope of practice of a Vocational Nurse. (ILOs: Ethics)
Assume responsibility and accountability for managing own actions. (ILOs: Ethics)
Advocate for healthcare consumers through political, economic, and societal activities. (ILOs: Personal Development)
Utilize technology to obtain and document patient data. (ILOs: Information Competency)
